One important correction: Superworks is an HRMS/payroll platform, not a managed corporate-travel provider. Its current product covers HR, payroll, recruitment, projects and performance management. 
Superworks

Provider	Current price	Key exclusions / caveats	Best fit
Superworks	Custom quote	No corporate-travel booking/management product	HR/payroll, not travel
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Free account; booking rates vary	Primarily self-service; dedicated human servicing is more limited	50-person SME wanting low-friction booking + GST/expense tools
Thomas Cook India	Custom quote	Fees/service model negotiated; potentially more expensive than self-service	Companies needing human travel support, visas, forex, MICE and offline servicing
FCM Travel	Custom quote	Enterprise implementation/program terms need negotiation	Companies wanting a formal TMC, negotiated corporate rates and managed travel

myBiz offers corporate fares, GST invoices, expense management, HRMS integrations and travel-request APIs. 
mybiz.makemytrip.com
 Thomas Cook provides air, hotel, rail, car, visa, forex, insurance and MICE, with dedicated corporate-travel technology. 
thomascook.in
+1
 FCM advertises corporate hotel rates and flexible cancellation options. 
fcmtravel.com

For a 50-person company, don't shortlist Superworks as the travel vendor. Get actual quotes from the other three and compare transaction fees, cancellation handling, GST reconciliation and after-hours support.
